shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat panel
repeated ornamental band along an edge
justification: The only real correspondence is the presence of rosette-like multi-petalled floral units, which in A form a dense all-over vegetal composition and in B appear only as a repeating border band framing the scene. A is a purely ornamental, non-figural plant/palmette design with no figures, while B is a narrative procession of human figures in profile leading a camel, so the subject matter, relationships and arrangement are essentially unrelated.
